title: With Raspberry Pi
description: Master Raspberry Pi with our comprehensive tutorials covering setup, programming, troubleshooting, and advanced projects. Perfect for beginners and experts alike.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Camera Setup and Troubleshooting: rpicam and Picamera2
items.content_html: Set up and troubleshoot Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3, HQ Camera, and AI Camera on current Raspberry Pi OS using rpicam-apps and Picamera2.

items.title: Raspberry Pi Connect Complete Guide: Secure Browser-Based Remote Access
items.content_html: Raspberry Pi Connect Complete Guide: Secure Browser-Based Remote Access. Follow Raspberry Pi setup, configuration, best practices, and troubleshooting steps.

items.title: Raspberry Pi OS Trixie Migration Guide: Safe Upgrade from Bookworm
items.content_html: Safely migrate a Raspberry Pi from Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm to Trixie. Back up Docker, services, SSH access, and data before a clean installation.

items.title: DevOps: Self-Hosted GitHub Actions Runner with Docker on Pi 5
items.content_html: Build a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner with Docker on Raspberry Pi 5. Automate ARM64 native builds and CI/CD pipelines in your homelab.

items.title: Edge AI: Running YOLOv8 with Vulkan GPU Acceleration via NCNN on Pi 5
items.content_html: Run YOLOv8 on Raspberry Pi 5 with Vulkan GPU acceleration. Compile ncnn framework and optimize object detection without external NPU hardware.

items.title: Network Mastery: WireGuard VPN Server with a Sleek Web UI via Docker
items.content_html: Deploy a WireGuard VPN server with a modern Web UI on Raspberry Pi using Docker Compose. Configure clients instantly using QR codes.

items.title: Smart Home: Advanced Home Assistant Dashboard Customization with CSS
items.content_html: Advanced guide to custom Home Assistant dashboards on Raspberry Pi. Install HACS and write CSS Lovelace cards for glassmorphism styles.

items.title: Cluster Mastery: Multi-Node K3s Cluster on Raspberry Pi 5
items.content_html: Build a multi-node Kubernetes cluster using K3s on Raspberry Pi 5. Configure cgroups, set up active Traefik ingress, and integrate with local DNS routing.

items.title: Edge AI: Face and Object Recognition with Google Coral TPU & Frigate
items.content_html: Set up real-time face and object recognition on Raspberry Pi 5 with Google Coral USB Accelerator and Frigate NVR. Optimize hardware-accelerated detectors.

items.title: High-Performance Storage: Btrfs RAID 1 with Transparent Compression on Pi 5
items.content_html: Build a high-performance Btrfs RAID 1 storage array on Raspberry Pi 5. Optimize disk redundancy, enable transparent zstd compression, and manage snapshots.

items.title: Smart Home: Connecting Zigbee Devices to Home Assistant Container via Docker
items.content_html: Integrate Zigbee smart devices with Home Assistant Container on Raspberry Pi. Configure Zigbee2MQTT and Mosquitto Broker using Docker Compose.

items.title: Edge AI: Running Llama 3.1 on Raspberry Pi 5 with Ollama, Open WebUI, and RAG
items.content_html: Run Llama 3.1 on Raspberry Pi 5. Complete guide to setting up Ollama, Open WebUI, and a local RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) assistant using LangChain.

items.title: Home Lab: Self-Hosted Monitoring Dashboard on Raspberry Pi 5
items.content_html: Home Lab: Self-Hosted Monitoring Dashboard on Raspberry Pi 5. Follow Raspberry Pi setup, configuration, best practices, and troubleshooting steps.

items.title: Network Mastery: Private DNS Server with AdGuard Home and Unbound over TLS
items.content_html: Set up a secure private DNS server on Raspberry Pi with AdGuard Home and Unbound. Configure DNS over TLS (DoT) to block ads and encrypt query traffic.

items.title: Retro Gaming: High-Performance PS2 and Sega Saturn Emulation on Raspberry Pi 5
items.content_html: Optimize Raspberry Pi 5 for PS2 and Sega Saturn emulation. Learn how to configure Vulkan graphics API, overclock the CPU, and install PCSX2/Yaba Sanshiro.

items.title: Edge AI: Building a Private Local AI Email Assistant on Raspberry Pi 5 with Ollama
items.content_html: Build a private AI email assistant on Raspberry Pi 5 with Ollama. Fetch emails via IMAP, categorize them with local LLMs, and send summaries to Discord.

items.title: Secure Infrastructure: Secure Remote Connections with WireGuard and Pi-hole on Raspberry Pi
items.content_html: Secure your remote connections and block ads on-the-go with WireGuard and Pi-hole on Raspberry Pi. Setting up PiVPN, DNS forwarding, and client profiles.

items.title: Storage Optimization: Btrfs File System with Transparent Compression and Snapshots on Raspberry Pi
items.content_html: Boost Raspberry Pi storage efficiency with the Btrfs file system. Learn to configure transparent zstd compression and create automated backups with snapshots.

items.title: Web Performance: High-Speed Nginx FastCGI Caching Optimization on Raspberry Pi 5
items.content_html: Supercharge web performance on Raspberry Pi 5 with Nginx FastCGI caching. Learn to cache dynamic requests in RAM (tmpfs) for near-instant load times.

items.title: Inline Assembly in C++ on Raspberry Pi
items.content_html: Master inline assembly in C++ on Raspberry Pi. Learn how to write assembly within C++ code, bind variables, use constraints, and optimize critical paths.
